workstreams.title: Krusty Krab Drive-Thru
workstreams.summary: Adding a drive-thru lane to the Krusty Krab so boat-driving customers can order Krabby Patties without coming inside.
workstreams.purpose: Increase daily patty sales and reduce queues at the counter during the lunchtime rush.

2026-10.progress: Speaker box installed. Customers still can't understand Squidward's mumbling through it.
2026-10.planned: Replace speaker box and train staff on clear ordering scripts.

2026-11.progress: New speaker box live. SpongeBob trialled the ordering script and average order time is down to 90 seconds.
2026-11.planned: Open the drive-thru for the full lunchtime shift and measure throughput.

keyResults.text: Drive-thru window and speaker box installed
Security camera covers the drive-thru window

risks.description: Plankton may use the drive-thru window as a new route to steal the secret formula.
risks.mitigation: Formula stays in the safe; security camera being installed at the window. Krabs reviewing footage daily.

risks.description: Issue: Squidward is the only cashier trained on the drive-thru till. Impact: no cover for his breaks.
risks.mitigation: SpongeBob being cross-trained. Complete by mid-December.

workstreams.title: Chum Bucket Customer Acquisition
workstreams.summary: Attempting to attract any customers at all to the Chum Bucket through a rebrand and new menu.
workstreams.purpose: Achieve the Chum Bucket's first sustained revenue and reduce dependence on stealing the Krabby Patty formula.

2026-10.progress: Karen ran a customer survey. One response, which turned out to be Plankton in disguise.
2026-10.planned: Launch the new 'Chum Deluxe' menu and a grand reopening event.

2026-11.progress: Grand reopening went ahead with zero attendees. Chum Deluxe pulled after a food safety complaint.
2026-11.planned: Karen to lead a review of the menu strategy. Pause formula-theft side projects to free up capacity.

keyResults.text: Pass Bikini Bottom food hygiene inspection
Three menu items that are not chum

risks.description: Issue: product is chum. Impact: nobody wants to eat it.
risks.mitigation: Menu review led by Karen. No mitigation agreed with Plankton yet.

risks.description: Key person dependency: the whole team is Plankton and Karen.
risks.mitigation: Karen backed up to cloud storage weekly.

risks.description: Ongoing schemes to steal the formula lead to legal action from the Krusty Krab.
risks.mitigation: None. Plankton has said he will 'definitely get it next time'.

workstreams.title: Treedome Underwater Science Programme
workstreams.summary: Sandy's research programme in the Treedome, building inventions that help land creatures live and work under the sea.
workstreams.purpose: Show that land-and-sea collaboration works and publish findings for the scientists back in Texas.

2026-10.progress: Air helmet v3 prototype passed pressure tests at 20 fathoms.
2026-10.planned: Begin field trials with SpongeBob as volunteer test subject.

2026-11.progress: Field trials complete. SpongeBob wore the helmet for 6 hours with no issues. Paper submitted to the Texas science committee.
2026-11.planned: Start design work on the karate practice dome extension.

keyResults.text: Submit paper to Texas science committee
Present findings at Bikini Bottom science fair

risks.description: Treedome seal failure could flood the lab and destroy research equipment.
risks.mitigation: Monthly seal inspections; backup air supply installed. Last inspection passed.

risks.description: Funding from Texas may be withdrawn if the paper is rejected.
risks.mitigation: Early peer review by fellow scientists showed positive feedback.

workstreams.title: Jellyfish Fields Safety Improvements
workstreams.summary: Making jellyfishing in Jellyfish Fields safer for residents and less stressful for the jellyfish.
workstreams.purpose: Reduce sting injuries among Bikini Bottom residents and protect the jellyfish population.

2026-11.progress: Safety leaflet drafted. Patrick lost the only copy, then found it under his rock.
2026-11.planned: Print leaflets and hold a jellyfishing safety workshop at the Krusty Krab.

keyResults.text: Sting reports down 50% year on year
Safety leaflet distributed to every household

risks.description: Patrick's attention span may delay delivery of the workshop.
risks.mitigation: SpongeBob is sharing ownership and sending daily reminders.

workstreams.title: Boating School Modernisation
workstreams.summary: Discovery into new teaching methods and a driving simulator for Mrs. Puff's Boating School.
workstreams.purpose: Raise the boating test pass rate and reduce damage to school boats and to Mrs. Puff.

2026-11.progress: Discovery started. Interviewed 12 students. SpongeBob failed his 38th driving test during the interview period.
2026-11.planned: Agree requirements for the boating simulator and get quotes from suppliers.

keyResults.text: Publish options appraisal for driving simulator

risks.description: Issue: repeated crashes during practical lessons. Impact: Mrs. Puff's insurance premiums keep rising.
risks.mitigation: Simulator expected to reduce on-road lessons. Mrs. Puff still inflating as a precaution.
